purpose: Denylist source of truth for pi_decision_policy (guard_quality / guard_scope). Two tiers, both never reachable by any candidate: `hard` = acceptance gates and architecture invariants (loosening masks a failure or changes what passes), `user_domain` = values that are the user's or the system's authority, not data-driven. Everything previously listed that is a legitimate tuning knob was released on 2026-09-24 (user decision, pi_jev_decisions_plan_de.md 1.1); see released_for_candidates for the conditions each candidate must meet. Enforcement in pi_decision_policy is still an allowlist (candidates_v1.json updates[].path); this file only refuses catalog entries that touch a protected path.

protected_path_prefixes.reason: Post-registration coverage/QC pass-fail thresholds (min_frames, min_supported_fraction, min_channel_n_eff_floor/fraction, min_analysis_pixels, max_internal_hole_area_px). Loosening any of these to make a marginal dataset pass is exactly the kind of silent quality erosion the guard exists to block.

Candidate-selection gates (fwhm_ratio_max, p90_fwhm_ratio_max, tail_ratio_max, elongation_ratio_max, background_rms_ratio_max, seam_ratio_max, min_stars_fwhm, min_stars_p90_tail_elongation, max_fwhm_ci_relative_width) that decide whether Multiband is promoted over Raw. These are the acceptance contract from AGENTS.md's architecture boundaries, not tuning knobs.
PCC color-calibration acceptance gate.
PCC color-calibration acceptance gate.
PCC color-calibration acceptance gate; rejects unstable calibration matrices.
AGENTS.md: the pipeline has exactly one reconstruction method (CFA Forward Drizzle + Multiband); no top-level method selector exists or may be reintroduced by any patch.

User preference for how much partially covered edge area is admitted; not derivable from the data (practical guide: 1.0 recommended for every setup). Loosening lets edge bias into metrics, BGE and PCC statistics.
Delivered canvas extent is the user's choice, not a data-driven tuning value.
Safety net chosen by the user; not a quality or throughput tuning value.
